BiblicalUsage: Mesha was the firstborn son of Caleb, the brother of Jerahmeel, and the father of Ziph. He is named once, in the genealogy of Judah, as the head of a family in the line of Caleb.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a single verse can still honour a man: Mesha is the firstborn of Caleb, and his sons carried the name of Ziph into the story of Judah.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
